Hi Sam,

I run growth at ClipForge, and we help agencies cut video editing time by 60%. I saw your team publishes about 40 short videos a week. Would you be open to a 15-minute call Thursday to see if we can save your editors a few hours a week? Happy to send a case study first.

Best,
Dana Morris
ClipForge
